page.title: Schedules
page.subtitle: Chats and orchestrations that start on a timetable
page.missedTitle: A window missed while Agentry was down is skipped, not replayed
page.missedBody: If the wrapper is not running when a slot comes due, that run is recorded as skipped and nothing is started late. Nobody is at the keyboard when a schedule fires, so a scheduled chat is denied any permission its mode does not already allow.
page.emptyBody: Start a chat or an orchestration every morning, every Monday, or every 15 minutes.

card.runNowHint: Start it now, whatever the timetable says
card.deleteBody: It stops firing and its run history is removed. Chats and orchestrations it already started are kept.
card.pausedNote: Paused: it will not fire until it is turned on

form.name: Name
form.dayOfMonthHint: A month without that day is skipped
form.cronHint: Five fields: minute, hour, day of month, month, day of week
form.cronBuilt: Built from the fields above; choose “Custom expression” to write it yourself
form.timezoneHint: The expression is read in this zone
form.invalidCron: This is not a valid cron expression
form.missedNote: If Agentry is not running when a slot comes due, that run is skipped, not replayed.
form.promptPlaceholder: What should Claude do each time?
form.tasksHint: Tasks run in parallel. Dependencies between tasks are kept as they were when you edit a schedule that has them.
form.worktree: Give each task its own git worktree
form.permissionModeHint: Nobody can answer a prompt when it fires, so anything the mode does not allow is denied
form.manualWarning: In manual mode every tool that needs approval is denied, so most scheduled work will stall. Choose a mode that allows what the task needs.
form.fromOrchestrationHint: Fills the fields below with a graph that already ran, as a relaunch would start it. Edit them before saving if you like.
